description: Abstract class for matching HTTP requests in MockServer, providing core matching logic, expectation management, and logging support.

classes.name: AbstractHttpRequestMatcher
classes.description: An abstract class that extends NotMatcher and implements HttpRequestMatcher, used for matching HTTP requests with expectation handling and logging.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets descriptive strings for matching failure messages.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the matcher with a new Expectation or RequestDefinition.

methods.name: setControlPlaneMatcher
methods.description: Sets whether the matcher is a control plane matcher.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Abstract method to apply matching logic to a RequestDefinition.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a RequestDefinition matches, with or without context.

methods.name: isResponseInProgress
methods.description: Indicates if a response is in progress.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source cause for matching.

methods.name: withSource
methods.description: Sets the source cause for matching.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the matcher is blank.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the matcher is active based on expectation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on expectation.
